about_short_description.short_description: PersistIQ is a sales outreach platform that automates prospecting, email outreach, calls, tasks, and social selling.

product.name: Chrome Extension for Prospecting
product.description: A browser extension that enables users to build targeted prospect lists by searching LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, finding emails, and adding prospects directly to outreach campaigns.

product.name: Campaigns Automation
product.description: A platform feature that automates personalized sales outreach via emails, calls, and tasks, including A/B testing and CRM data synchronization.

product.name: Reporting and Analytics
product.description: A reporting tool that tracks and analyzes the performance of messages, campaigns, and team members, including metrics like task completion, replies, sentiment, and meetings.

product.name: CRM Integrations
product.description: Native bi-directional synchronization with CRM systems like Copper, Salesforce, and PersistIQ’s own CRM, enabling contact and activity syncing and campaign management within the CRM.

product.name: Sales-Ready AI Email Replies
product.description: An AI-powered tool that generates customized, automatic email responses tailored to company-specific information, integrated with Gmail and adaptable over time.

product.name: Lead Management Features on Import
product.description: Features that allow assigning lead owners and lead statuses automatically when importing leads into PersistIQ to improve lead tracking and distribution.
